avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inducer may decrease bromocriptine levels and reduce therapeutic efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; select alternative supplement or monitor for loss of therapeutic effect

avoid_supplements.name: Metoclopramide-containing supplements
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Dopamine antagonist directly opposes bromocriptine's mechanism of action
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid; use alternative antiemetics if needed

avoid_supplements.name: Ergot alkaloid supplements
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Additive ergot toxicity risk including vasospasm, hypertension, and ischemia

caution_supplements.name: Grapefruit seed extract
caution_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibitor may increase bromocriptine plasma concentrations
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for adverse effects (nausea, dizziness, orthostatic hypotension)

caution_supplements.name: Vitamin B6 (high-dose >100mg daily)
caution_supplements.mechanism: May reduce bromocriptine effectiveness in prolactin suppression
caution_supplements.action: Limit B6 supplementation; monitor prolactin levels if used

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit and grapefruit juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition increases bromocriptine bioavailability and adverse effect risk
avoid_foods.action: Avoid consumption; select alternative citrus fruits

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May delay absorption and reduce peak plasma levels of bromocriptine
caution_foods.action: Take bromocriptine with food if GI upset occurs; consistent timing recommended

caution_foods.name: Tyramine-rich foods (aged cheeses, cured meats, fermented foods)
caution_foods.mechanism: Potential hypertensive response due to dopamine agonist effects on catecholamine regulation
caution_foods.action: No strict avoidance required but moderate intake; monitor blood pressure

monitoring_notes: Monitor blood pressure regularly, particularly upon initiation and with dose increases. Assess for ergot toxicity signs (peripheral vasoconstriction, chest pain) and monitor prolactin levels in therapeutic use. Counsel patients on orthostatic hypotension risk and potential drug-food interactions affecting absorption.
